en-GB.codex_rules_attacking_text2:
▶ A unit’s Attack Power (ATK) is
  tied to its Health (HP).

▶ All units begin with full ATK. 
  ATK decreases as the unit
  loses HP.

▶ A unit at 0 HP has no ATK.
  (And is also dead.)
en-GB.codex_rules_beach_combat_text:
▶ Generally, most ground-based units cannot attack enemies at sea. 

▶ However, land units and naval units can always attack each other if their target is on Beach terrain.
en-GB.codex_rules_charge_text:
Your commander's groove charges whenever ANY of your units does the following:
  
  ▶ Attacks
  ▶ Counter-attacks
  ▶ Defeats a unit
  ▶ Neutralizes a structure
  ▶ Captures a structure
en-GB.codex_rules_charge_text2:
Below is the groove charge gained for each action. (‡ = Charge via commander action.)

▶ Attack a unit:     +3 /  +8‡
▶ Counter-attack:    +2 /  +6‡
▶ Defeat a unit:     +6 / +12‡
▶ Defeat structure:  +6 / +12‡
▶ Capture structure: +4 / +10‡
en-GB.codex_rules_conquest_text:
▶ A series of random battles.
▶ Units, health, gold, and items
  persist from map to map.
▶ Unit deaths are permanent.
▶ Lose, and you'll start over.
▶ Defeat the Boss to win!
en-GB.codex_rules_groove_damage_text:
▶ Groove damage is usually based on the attack power of a Commander at full health.

▶ So, a groove that deals "50% of full attack damage" does half the damage as a Commander attacking while at full health.
en-GB.codex_rules_groove_speed_text:
▶ The charge required to reach 100% and 200% differs for each commander. 

▶ For example, Ragna's groove takes 150 points to reach 100% charge, and 100 to go from 100% to 200% (or 250 points total).
en-GB.codex_rules_groove_speed_text2:
Here are the precise charge points required to charge a groove of a given speed:

  ▶ Very Fast:   50
  ▶ Fast:        75
  ▶ Medium:     100
  ▶ Slow:       150
  ▶ Very Slow:  200
  ▶ Lethargic:   250
en-GB.codex_rules_groove_text2:
▶ To use a Groove, you must
  have at least 100% Groove 
  charge. (See next page.)

▶ At 200% Groove charge,
  your Commander can unleash
  a supercharged version of
  their Groove. 200% Grooves
  often have wider effects.
en-GB.codex_rules_items_text:
Non-commander units can use Items to gain advantages in combat.


▶ Equippable items boost stats.

▶ Consumable items provide an 
  immediate bonus. (e.g., healing)

▶ Items are lost upon unit death
  See the Catalog tab for details 
  on specific items and their 
  effects.
en-GB.codex_rules_optional_objectives_text:
▶ In campaign mode, optional objectives are intended for players who crave a tougher challenge. 

▶ Completing optional objectives increases your score for that mission - but there’s no reward beyond a job well done.
en-GB.codex_rules_pushpull_text:
▶ Several unit abilities, items, and grooves allow units to be forcibly moved from their current position. These abilities all follow certain rules:

  ● Enemy Commanders cannot be
    forcibly moved.
en-GB.codex_rules_pushpull_text2:
● If the forced movement causes
    one unit to bump into another,
    both units will take 20
    collision damage.

  ● If a unit is moved onto terrain
    they cannot normally stand on
    (including structures), that
    unit will be killed.‡


  ‡ Exception: Land-based units
    that cannot stand on 
    Mountains (ex. Giants) will
    take collision damage instead
    of being killed when pushed
    onto these tiles.

en-GB.ui_demo_end_text:
Thank you for playing!

This is a small snapshot at our in-development game-mode, Conquest Mode, completely new to Wargroove 2! You can expect to unlock and take on new trials with various Commanders as you climb the ranks of this challenging roguelike game-mode.  

Wargroove 2 at launch will include:
6 Factions with 22 Commanders
3 campaigns, interwoven by an explosive conclusion
5 new units, bringing the total unit types to 26
New game mode: Conquest mode
Local and Online multiplayer
Map & custom campaign creation tools
Original OST by Dale North

Wishlist now!
